subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should the embedded-runner remainder move entirely under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 while this issue narrows to Discord monitor cleanup?
rationale: Current main partially implemented the runner side through the RuntimePlan program, but no canonical item owns the distinct remaining Discord cleanup; automation should not choose that tracking boundary.

options.title: Split ownership
options.body: Keep remaining runner work in the RuntimePlan RFC and narrow this issue to Discord preflight, processing, and provider boundaries.

options.title: Keep umbrella
options.body: Continue using this issue as a cross-area staged tracker for both runner and Discord cleanup.

recommendation.title: Split ownership
recommendation.body: Keep remaining runner work in the RuntimePlan RFC and narrow this issue to Discord preflight, processing, and provider boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current issue review and has strong recent history across both affected surfaces.
